ideas.pitch: A Python and C++ profiling tool that parses source code, runs automated stress-tests against custom edge cases, and dynamically plots time and space complexity growth rates to help competitive programmers identify suboptimal bottlenecks.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Complexity Visualizer and Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Code Clash is fundamentally an ICPC-style competitive programming contest focused on algorithmic efficiency and optimization under strict time constraints. A tool that helps programmers debug complexity issues appeals directly to the core competencies of the judges.

ideas.pitch: A command-line utility in C++ and Python that automatically minifies competitive programming templates, expands custom shorthand macros, and generates fast I/O boilerplate tailored for online judging environments.
ideas.title: CP Template and Snippet Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the speed and optimization requirements of strict time-constraint competitive programming events makes this immediately useful to participants and aligned with the event's exact focus.

ideas.pitch: A specialized fuzz testing tool written in C++ or Python that takes a problem statement description or brute-force reference solution and automatically generates extreme boundary-value test cases to catch edge-case bugs in competitive programming solutions.
ideas.title: Automated CP Test Case Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the rigorous algorithmic problem-solving and optimization theme of Code Clash by solving the exact validation challenges faced by competitors during high-pressure contests.

ideas.pitch: An offline execution benchmarking harness that compares the exact execution time and memory footprint of an algorithm implemented across C, C++, Java, and Python under identical constraint bounds.
ideas.title: Multi-Language Solution Benchmarker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages the four supported programming languages of the hackathon, providing practical insights into language overhead for algorithmic optimization.

ideas.pitch: An interactive visualization engine for complex graph and dynamic programming algorithms that steps through state transitions and memory allocations in real-time.
ideas.title: Graph Algorithm Step-by-Step Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines deep algorithmic problem-solving with intuitive execution visualization, appealing to the logical thinking and optimization criteria of ICPC-style judges.
